commit 24ac1b28bba0c117a29fe72f8ae1a8ed69b76c26
Author: Tim Rühsen <tim.ruehsen@gmx.de>
Date:   Wed Feb 20 22:24:20 2019 +0100

    Allow _ as basic code point in domain labels

diff --git a/lib/puny_decode.c b/lib/puny_decode.c
index f99c43c..0c2f10a 100644
--- a/lib/puny_decode.c
+++ b/lib/puny_decode.c
@@ -84,7 +84,7 @@ enum { base = 36, tmin = 1, tmax = 26, skew = 38, damp = 700,
        initial_bias = 72, initial_n = 0x80, delimiter = 0x2D };

 /* basic(cp) tests whether cp is a basic code point: */
-#define basic(cp) ((cp >= 'a' && cp <= 'z') || (cp >= '0' && cp <='9') || (cp >= 'A' && cp <='Z') || cp == 0x2D)
+#define basic(cp) ((cp >= 'a' && cp <= 'z') || (cp >= '0' && cp <='9') || (cp >= 'A' && cp <='Z') || cp == '-' || cp == '_')

 /* delim(cp) tests whether cp is a delimiter: */
 #define delim(cp) ((cp) == delimiter)
diff --git a/tests/test-lookup.c b/tests/test-lookup.c
index 5c4ef21..ffbe08e 100644
--- a/tests/test-lookup.c
+++ b/tests/test-lookup.c
@@ -834,6 +834,8 @@ static const struct idna idna[] = {
   {"_443._tcp.example.com", "_443._tcp.example.com", IDN2_INVALID_FLAGS, IDN2_NONTRANSITIONAL|IDN2_NO_TR46},
   {"_443._tcp.example.com", "_443._tcp.example.com", IDN2_INVALID_FLAGS, IDN2_TRANSITIONAL|IDN2_NO_TR46},
   {"_443._tcp.example.com", "_443._tcp.example.com", IDN2_INVALID_FLAGS, IDN2_TRANSITIONAL|IDN2_NONTRANSITIONAL|IDN2_NO_TR46},
+  /* underscore and non-ASCII */
+  {"\xc3\xa4_x", "xn--_x-uia", IDN2_OK, IDN2_TRANSITIONAL},
 };

 static int ok = 0, failed = 0;
